description: Update an existing contact's mutable fields (name, tags, custom field values). Only the fields you supply are changed. REST: POST /contacts/{contactId}.

customFieldValues.description: Custom field values to set (each { customFieldId, value:[...] }).

value.description: The value(s) for the custom field (array, even for single values).

tags.description: Array of tag ids to set on the contact.

name: getresponse_update_contact
title: Update contact
